name: academic-dashboard-mcp
description: Claude connector (MCP) for Academic Dashboard: talks to the running app through its local bridge

scripts.bundle: pnpm dlx esbuild@0.25.10 server.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/server.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.pack: pnpm bundle && pnpm dlx @anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2 pack . academic-dashboard.mcpb
